title: 1995 AHSME Problem 1
statement: Kim earned scores of \(87,\) \(83\) and \(88\) on her first three mathematics examinations. If Kim receives a score of \(90\) on the fourth exam, then her average will

solutions.text: The first three scores total \(87+83+88=258,\) so their average is \(\frac{258}{3}=86.\) With the fourth score, the total is \(348,\) and the new average is \(\frac{348}{4}=87.\) It increases by \(1,\) so the correct answer is B.
hints: Compare \(90\) with the average of the first three scores
Find the old and new totals before dividing by the number of exams
